title: The film 'Woman Unknown' wins the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival
summary: The Nordic drama takes the top prize while the Japanese films 'Look Back' and 'Nelson' go empty-handed.

title: The U.S. Open crowns Rybakina in women's singles and Kamiji in wheelchair
summary: The New York tournament yields titles for the Kazakh in singles, the Japanese in wheelchair, and Shelton's first Grand Slam final in men's.

title: Houthis expand control in the Red Sea and southern Yemen, escalating oil tension
summary: The Yemeni group captures strategic areas, increases displaced persons, and threatens oil routes as Iran gains influence.

title: A motorcyclist dies in Osaka after a police chase and a fall
summary: Police were pursuing the driver, who lost control of the motorcycle and died; the investigation continues.

title: Voting begins in the Okinawa gubernatorial election with six candidates
summary: Early voting turnout decreases slightly as the campaign focuses on the Henoko base and the economy.

title: The autumn sumo tournament kicks off with ōzeki Aonishiki confident in his preparation
summary: The 15-day championship begins in Tokyo with attention on the new ōzeki's debut and the battle for the yūshō.

title: Modi and Xi meet at the BRICS summit and agree to stabilize bilateral relations
summary: The leaders of India and China hold their third consecutive meeting and highlight progress, though mistrust persists.

title: Haruka Kitaguchi breaks the Japanese javelin record with 68.92 m at the Ultimate Championship
summary: The Olympic champion surpasses her own mark by 1.54 meters and takes the title in the new national competition.

title: Japan crushes the U.S. with nine tries and will play the Pacific Nations Cup final against Fiji
summary: The Brave Blossoms dominate the Eagles in Osaka and secure their spot in the Pacific tournament final.

title: Fire at an acupuncture clinic in Saitama leaves two dead, a couple in their 70s
summary: The fire broke out in the building housing the clinic and residence; firefighters found the bodies after extinguishing the flames.

title: Putin visits the Kuril Islands and Japan protests while the government avoids tough measures due to energy
summary: The Russian president sets foot on the disputed islands for the first time in a month; Tokyo limits itself to a diplomatic protest.

title: Torrential rains flood half of Chiba's underpasses and the government urges regulation of their access
summary: The storm leaves 3,100 abandoned vehicles and forces a review of evacuation plans and early warnings.

title: The Ministry of Internal Affairs deletes chats after an information request, according to the opposition
summary: The administration deleted records of administrative guidance and prepared questions for press conferences following a disclosure request.
